title: AI Prompting Power with Tomi Abe
description: A practical prompting and generative workflow session for Loblaw Digital's AI Committee.
content:
I joined Loblaw Digital's AI Committee for a focused session on using generative AI in creative and design work.

The talk covered prompt structure, iteration habits, critique loops, and ways to bring AI tools into real production workflows without flattening craft or judgment.

I kept the session practical: how to brief the model, how to pressure-test outputs, when to change direction, and how to use generated material as working material rather than finished thinking.
